master_options.title: Production Time
master_options.description:
Production cut-off time for new orders is 10 am Mountain Time (Arizona).
All orders after this cut-off, the production timeline will start on the next business day.

All time estimates are based on proof approved.

attributes.attr_desc: No White Ink Printed.

attributes.label: Undercolor
attributes.attr_desc: Print White Ink In the Color areas only (Above or Below Color).

attributes.label: Day Night
attributes.attr_desc: 3-Layer Printing consisting of Color / White Flood / Color. This is used for correct color saturation both Front and Backlit.

attributes.label: Dual View
attributes.attr_desc: 5-Layer Printing Method to display Two separate images in 2 Viewing directions. Layered as Color/White/Blockout/White/Mirrored Color

attributes.label: Full Flood
attributes.attr_desc: Flood Entire Surface with White Ink (Above or Below Color).

attributes.label: Spot White
attributes.attr_desc: Print White Ink in only designated spots (Above or Below Color) or in White areas of the Image.

master_options.title: Custom Hole Spacing (in)
master_options.description: Input a custom spacing in Inches. This spacing will effect all sides. Will adjust to be evenly spaced up to a maximum of the number input.

master_options.title: Sheet Size
master_options.description:
*Tip for Selecting Sheet Size

Choosing the right sheet size is essential for efficiency and cost savings. Select a sheet size as close as possible to your product dimensions. This minimizes material waste, reduces production costs, and ensures a more sustainable process—all without compromising quality.
